components.name: Confirm All (armed)
components.description: Moves every ready file, so it takes two taps. Armed: the solid teal gives way to a teal outline on the teal wash, naming the count; an inset ring keeps the size.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; } .ds-all { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: #00d4aa; color: #0f0f23; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-all:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-all:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a9eff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-all-armed { background: #0f2b2e; color: #00d4aa; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #00d4aa; }

components.name: Quiet Delete
components.description: Destructive but recoverable (trash): a borderless Fault Red text action under confirm. The first tap arms it (red edge, faint red wash) and says what will happen.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; } .ds-quiet { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; color: #ff5757; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-quiet:hover { background: rgba(255, 87, 87, 0.12); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a9eff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-armed { border-color: #ff5757; background: rgba(255, 87, 87, 0.12); }

components.name: Text Field

components.name: Switch
components.description: role="switch" checkboxes (notifications, debug mode). Off: Shelf Navy track, Faded Text thumb at the start. On: Signal Blue track, Night Ink thumb at the end (inset-inline-start, so RTL needs no flip).
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; color: #e8e8e8; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 2.75rem; height: 1.5rem; margin: 0; border: 1px solid #2a2a3e; border-radius: 999px; background: #16213e; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-switch input::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; inset-inline-start: 0.1875rem; width: 1.0625rem; height: 1.0625rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #a0a0a0; transform: translateY(-50%); transition: inset-inline-start 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-switch input:checked { border-color: #4a9eff; background: #4a9eff; } .ds-switch input:checked::before { inset-inline-start: calc(100% - 1.25rem); background: #0f0f23; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a9eff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A quiet late-night workroom for cataloguing recordings. The room is deep navy, and the surfaces step up in small tonal increments the way shelves sit in low light. One cool blue marks the thing you can act on. Teal appears only when something is settled: a file confirmed, a save done. Amber and red stay rare and mean exactly one thing each.

The tool serves devotional content, so it stays calm. Density favours the review card: fields are full width, labels sit above inputs, and the primary action spans the card. Arabic RTL is the native direction. Latin fragments (paths, tokens, IDs, file extensions) are isolated islands inside it, never the other way round.

Every fill is solid. Teal confirm is the one saturated action on a card. The only gradient left is the brand mark, the app icon itself, beside the title. Nothing lifts or glows on hover. Sprint 4's design pass (B5–B9) removed the louder habits it inherited: gradient fills, gradient title text, hover lift, emoji icons.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, navy not black; depth from tonal steps and 1px seams.
One action colour (signal blue), one completion colour (settled teal).
Cairo for everything Arabic; system mono for paths and code.
Full-width, thumb-reachable controls on a 390px phone.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each signal colour means one thing. Blue is "you can act", teal is "done", amber is "look at this", red is "failed or destructive". Never use teal for a neutral action or blue for success.

rules.name: The Dark Text On Light Fill Rule
rules.body: Text on blue or teal fills is Night Ink, not white. White on Signal Blue measured about 2.5:1.

rules.name: The No Fake Italic Rule
rules.body: Cairo has no italic, so `font-style: italic` renders a synthesized oblique. Mark secondary text with tone or size instead.

rules.name: The Steady Digits Rule
rules.body: Digits stay Western (they sit next to Latin paths and IDs). Counts, the nav badge, pagination, library stats, rescan progress and similarity scores use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so they don't jitter while updating.

rules.name: The Isolated Latin Rule
rules.body: Paths, file extensions, tokens and chat IDs are wrapped in `<bdi>` or set `dir="ltr"`, so the bidi algorithm never reorders them inside Arabic prose.

rules.name: The Sticky Minimum Rule
rules.body: Only what you need while scrolling sticks: the library's browse panel (about 130px) and, on phones, the queue's ready bar. Page headers, stats and notices scroll away.

rules.name: The One Way In, One Way Out Rule
rules.body: Multi-select has one entry (the «تحديد متعدد» toggle, `aria-pressed`, fixed label) and one labelled exit («إنهاء التحديد» in the selection bar). In selection mode the whole track card is the toggle and the checkbox shows its state; no per-card select buttons.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces don't cast shadows at rest. Only overlays float.

rules.name: The Explained Change Rule
rules.body: Every animation names a change of state: arrived, left, opened, saving. A card that didn't change doesn't move. Rebuilding the list must never replay an entrance.

rules.name: The Named Property Rule
rules.body: Transitions list their properties. No `transition: all`, and no animation of layout properties (width, height, padding, margins, top/left).

rules.name: The Still Under Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the fades stay (they still say "this changed") and all movement goes: no translate, no FLIP slide, no sweep, no spin. `app.js` reads the same media query.

dos: Do keep text on Signal Blue or Settled Teal fills in Night Ink.
Do isolate every Latin fragment (path, extension, token, ID) with `<bdi>` or `dir="ltr"`.
Do give phone touch targets at least 44px and keep primary actions full width.
Do use Shelf Navy panels with 0.5rem corners for status and preview blocks inside a card.
donts: Don't add a light theme. The product is dark only.
Don't use religious imagery (calligraphy, domes, geometric patterns) as decoration.
Don't introduce playful motion or celebration effects (no confetti).
Don't animate a card that didn't change state, and don't lift anything on hover (see The Explained Change Rule).
Don't give a signal colour a second meaning (see The One Meaning Rule).
Don't add shadows to surfaces at rest (see The Flat-At-Rest Rule).
